items.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
items.excerpt: Shopify says more than a billion product listings from its merchants will be available to third-party AI shopping agents, widening agentic commerce distribution beyond its existing partners.

items.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
items.excerpt: American Express published an 'intent intelligence' framework so merchants can verify that an AI shopping agent's purchase matches what the cardholder actually authorized, aiming to cut disputes as agentic checkout grows.

items.title: Salesforce trains its Koa model on 27 years of CRM workflow simulations
items.excerpt: Salesforce's chief data officer says its Koa model was trained on simulations of 27 years of CRM sales and service workflows, while customers can still swap in Claude, ChatGPT, open or custom models for Agentforce agents.

items.title: Bannerflow now scores ads for attention before any budget is spent
items.excerpt: Bannerflow's new Creative Intelligence suite adds AI attention heatmaps and clarity scores to pre-test ad creative before launch, alongside AI image tools and plain-language feed setup; pricing and validation data are not yet disclosed.

items.title: Meta's shopping agent must fill its top 5 picks with well-known merchants
items.excerpt: An instruction file for Meta's Muse shopping agent requires its top five product picks to come from well-known merchants, and only Meta catalog items get in-chat checkout, leaving challenger brands outside the comparison.

items.title: Media Buying Briefing: Synthetic audience adoption by agencies and clients takes off
items.excerpt: Media planners, creative strategists and CMOs are increasingly basing media and creative decisions on insights from AI-generated synthetic consumers, Digiday reports.

items.title: For some publishers, agentic advertising is still a question of ROI
items.excerpt: Despite the hype around agentic media buying, some publishers remain skeptical that AI agents transacting ad inventory will deliver meaningful incremental revenue.

items.title: Gen Z, Gen Alpha and the AI-ificiation of retail this holiday season
items.excerpt: Younger shoppers are leaning on AI tools for holiday product discovery even as they crave physical experiences, pushing retailers to balance AI shopping assistants with stores.

items.title: To Sell ChatGPT to Businesses, OpenAI Is Going Back to Field Marketing
items.excerpt: OpenAI is betting on face-to-face field marketing and events to convert ChatGPT's consumer recognition into enterprise sales.

items.title: Tesco Media announces the launch of new ad platform, shoppable formats and smarter in-store media
items.excerpt: At its 2026 Upfront, Tesco Media unveiled a new retail media ad platform and shoppable formats, and said it is developing AI-powered conversational audience recommendations plus AI workflows to cut advertisers' manual campaign tasks.

items.title: How Lowe's is building — and measuring — a full-funnel media network
items.excerpt: Lowe's is expanding its retail media network to new platforms and rolling out incrementality tools and AI optimization for advertisers.

items.title: Brands Briefing: As AI reshapes retail, brands are investing even more in stores
items.excerpt: Executives at Rhone, Anthropologie, Kohl's, Brunt and Crocs explain why they are doubling down on physical stores even as AI shopping agents reshape online product discovery.
